f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: To return to a topic later. Often used to postpone a decision.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: To return to a topic later. Often used to postpone a decision.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: その場で決着をつけず、時間を置いて議題を再開することを指す。
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: 後の时机? に同じ話題へ戻ることを指す表現。

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: 논의하던 주제를 잠시 미루었다가 나중에 다시 꺼내는 것을 뜻하며, 특히 결정이나 답을 나중에 하기로 할 때 자주 사용합니다.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: 어떤 주제를 나중에 다시 다루는 일.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: Retomar uma discussão ou um tema em outro momento, geralmente quando o assunto fica para depois. É uma expressão do meio corporativo usada com frequência para adiar decisões.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: Voltar a um assunto mais tarde, muitas vezes para adiar uma decisão.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: Kembali kepada suatu topik untuk dibahas kemudian, terutama ketika keputusannya ingin ditunda sampai ada informasi atau waktu yang lebih tepat.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: Tindakan kembali membahas sebuah topik pada kesempatan berikutnya.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: การยกกลับมาเรื่องหรือคำถามเดิมเพื่อพิจารณาอีกครั้ง มักใช้เพื่อเลื่อนการตัดสินใจไปก่อน
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: การกลับมาพิจารณาหัวข้อเดิมในภายหลัง

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.definition: Görüşmede o an çözülemeyen bir konuyu daha sonra ele almak için kullanılır. Kararın ertelenmesini ifade edebilir.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.gloss: Bir konuya daha sonra yeniden dönme eylemi.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: Bütçe sorusunu öğle yemeğinden sonra yeniden ele alalım.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: การกลับมาพิจารณาคำถามเรื่องงบประมาณหลังอาหารเป็นแนวทางที่ทุกคนเห็นพ้องต้องกัน

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: Mari kita kembali membahas pertanyaan tentang anggaran setelah makan siang.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: Vamos dar um circle back na questão do orçamento depois do almoço.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: 예산 문제는 점심 이후에 다시 다루기로 합시다.

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.
f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.translation: 予算のことは昼食後に戻して検討しましょう。

f504b21df9b1220257924729ca3f60b38c394285.text: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: The numbers inside a model that hold what it learned. Each one is a weight that raises or lowers the chance of a continuation.
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: The numbers inside a model that hold what it learned. Each one is a weight that raises or lowers the chance of a continuation.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: モデルが学習した情報を数値として保持する要素。各パラメータは、続く文章の可能性!!!!!!!! règlesする重みとして働く。
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: モデル内部で学習内容を保持する数値群。

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: 각 매개변수는 가중치 역할을 하며, 다음 말을 이어 갈 확률을 높이거나 낮춥니다. 일반 사용자가 그 값을 직접 읽어 이해하기는 어렵습니다.
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: 인공지능 모델 안에서 학습된 정보를 저장하는 숫자들입니다.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: São valores que ajudam o modelo a relacionar elementos do texto e a escolher suas continuações. Em geral, não correspondem diretamente a frases ou fatos que o usuário possa ler.
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: Parâmetros são os números internos que armazenaram o que o modelo aprendeu.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: Setiap parameter merupakan bobot yang meningkatkan atau menurunkan kemungkinan suatu kelanjutan muncul. Parameter bukan bagian yang dapat dibaca atau dipahami secara langsung oleh manusia.
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: Parameter adalah angka-angka di dalam model yang menyimpan pengetahuan yang dipelajari.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: พารามิเตอร์คือตัวเลขภายในโมเดลที่เก็บข้อมูลจากสิ่งที่โมเดลเรียนรู้ แต่ละตัวทำหน้าที่เป็นน้ำหนักที่เพิ่มหรือลดโอกาสของการต่อข้อความแต่ละแบบ ไม่ใช่ประโยคที่อ่านเข้าใจได้โดยตรง
f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.gloss: ตัวเลขภายในโมเดลที่เก็บสิ่งที่โมเดลเรียนรู้

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.definition: Her biri, modelin bir sonraki devamını üretme olasılığını artırabilen veya azaltabilen sayılardır. Modelin eğitim sırasında öğrendiği bilgiler bu parametrelerde temsil edilir.

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.translation: Modelin milyarlarca parametresi var, ancak bunların hiçbiri doğrudan okunabilen bir cümle değildir.
โมเดลนี้มีพารามิเตอร์หลายพันล้านตัว แต่ไม่ใช่จำนวนที่อ่านออกเป็นประโยคได้
Model itu memiliki miliaran parameter, tetapi tidak satu pun merupakan kalimat yang dapat dibaca manusia.
O modelo tem bilhões de parâmetros, mas nenhum deles corresponde diretamente a uma frase legível.
이 모델에는 수십억 개의 매개변수가 있지만 그중 하나를 문장으로 읽어 내기는 어렵습니다.
このモデルには数十億個のパラメータがある。

f528212a496dc7a0e9a57c129b561aa4609364d7.text: The model has billions of parameters, and not one of them is a sentence you can read.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: How a person presents their gender through clothes, voice, gesture and behaviour.
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: How a person presents their gender through clothes, voice, gesture and behaviour.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: 衣服、話し方、仕草、行動によって、その人が自分の性別をどう表しているかを指す。性別そのものではない点で、自分の性別の感覚とは別のものです。
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: 衣服、話し方、仕草、行動によって、その人が自分の性別をどう表しているかを指す。

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: 개인이 자신의 젠더를 외부에 보여 주는 방식을 뜻한다. 자신이 어떤 성별에 속한다고 느끼는 감각인 젠더 정체성과는 구별된다.
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: 옷차림, 목소리, 몸짓과 행동으로 자신의 성별을 드러내는 방식.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: Manifestação do gênero por meio de roupas, gestos, voz, attestação de comportamento e outros sinais exteriorizados. Não deve ser confundida com a identidade de gênero.
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: Forma como uma pessoa manifesta seu gênero por meios externos.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: Cara seseorang menampilkan gender melalui pakaian, suara, gerak tubuh, dan perilaku. Bentuk ekspresi ini tidak selalu menunjukkan identitas gender-nya.
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: Cara seseorang menampilkan gender melalui pakaian, suara, gerak tubuh, dan perilaku.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: การสื่อออกเพศของตนผ่านรูปลักษณ์ภายนอกและพฤติกรรมต่าง ๆ เช่น การแต่งตัว การใช้น้ำเสียง กริยา หรือแบบพฤติกรรม คำนี้พูดถึงการแสดงออก ไม่ใช่อัตลักษณ์เพศของตน
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: วิธีที่บุคคลแสดงออกเพศของตนผ่านเสื้อผ้า น้ำเสียง ท่าทาง และพฤติกรรม

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.definition: Bir kişinin toplumsal cinsiyetini kıyafet, ses tonu, jest ve davranışlar yoluyla nasıl gösterdiği. Kişinin cinsiyet kimliğinden farklı olarak, başkalarının onu nasıl algıladığıyla ilgilidir.
f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.gloss: Bir kişinin cinsiyetini giysi, ses, jest ve davranışla dışa vurma biçimi.

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.translation: Yeni bir işe başladığında cinsiyet ifadesi değişti ve çevresinde daha rahat hissetmeye başladı.
การแสดงออกเพศของเขาเปลี่ยนไปเมื่อเริ่มงานใหม่ และความเหมาะสมก็ง่ายขึ้น
Ekspresi gender-nya berubah setelah ia mulai bekerja di tempat baru, dan ia merasa lebih mudah berbaasa.
A expressão de gênero dela mudou depois que começou a trabalhar em um novo lugar.
새 직업을 시작하면서 그의 젠더 표현이 달라졌고, 그 변화는 훨씬 자연스러워졌다.
新しい仕事を始めたとき、彼の性別の表し方は変わり、ほどよく合うようになった。

f53bfb186ccaf78d166ce980ec1db9366a74bb7f.text: His gender expression changed when he started a new job, and the fit got easier.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: The disorientation you feel when the everyday rules of a place stop matching the ones you grew up with.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: The disorientation you feel when the everyday rules of a place stop matching the ones you grew up with.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: その場所の日常のルールが、育った頃の自分の日常のルールと合わなくなったときに感じる混乱や不安です。
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: 慣れた生活環境が変わったときに生じるoriented 不安。

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: 그동안 accustomed한 사회 관습이나 생활 규칙이 갑자기 달라졌을 때 방향을 잃고 혼란을 느끼는 현상이다.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: 익숙한 지역의 생활 방식과 다른 환경에 적응하지 못해 생기는 혼란이다.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: Confusão e desconforto tweaked ao se deparar com hábitos, regras ou padrões sociais diferentes daqueles com os quais se está acostumado. É comum quando alguém se muda para um país ou uma região com outra cultura.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: Desorientação causada por costumes e regras diferentes dos que você conhece.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: Kejutan mental yang muncul ketika cara hidup, kebiasaan, atau aturan di suatu tempat tidak sesuai dengan yang Anda kenal sejak kecil.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: Perasaan bingung dan tidak adjusts ketika aturan kebiasaan di tempat lain berbeda.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: ความรู้สึกหลงและสับสนเมื่อพบวิธีใช้ชีวิตและกฎทางสังคมของสถานที่หนึ่งแตกต่างจากสิ่งที่เติบโตมากำเนิด
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: ความสับสนที่เกิดขึ้นเมื่อกฎขนบธรรมเนียมของท้องถิ่นต่างจากที่คุ้นเคย

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.definition: Yaşanılan yerdeki günlük kurallar ve alışkanlıklar önceki yaşam alışkanlıklarından farklıysa ortaya çıkan tedirginliktir. Yalnızca bir yeri beğenmemek değil, günlük yaşamı sürdürmekte zorlanmaktır.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.gloss: Bir yere taşındıktan sonra alışıldık kuralların artık kendi alışkanlıklarına uymadığı hissi.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: Altıdan sonra açık bir market bulamayınca kültür şoku yaşadım.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: สัปดาห์ที่ฉันหาร้านสุปpermarket ที่ยังเปิดหลังหกโมงไม่พบ ฉันรู้สึกช็อกทางวัฒนธรรมมาก

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: Saya mengalami guncangan budaya pada minggu ketika saya tidak menemukan supermarket yang buka setelah pukul enam.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: O choque cultural começou na semana em que não encontrei nenhum supermercado aberto depois das seis.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: 저녁 여섯 시 이후에 문을 여는 곳을 찾지 못했을 때 culture shock을 느꼈다.

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.
f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.translation: 午後6時以降営業しているスーパーを見つけられなかった週、文化ショックを感じました。

f5469c8914c5f64509c422e7c0f0a7d629f8dadc.text: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: Wheat grain ground into a fine powder. It is the main part of the bread.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: Wheat grain ground into a fine powder. It is the main part of the bread.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: 小麦を粉に加工したもので、パンや麺などの原料になる。
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: 小麦を細かく挽いて粉にしたもの。

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: 밀을 곱게 갈아 만든 가루로, 빵을 만들 때 주로 사용한다.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: 밀을 곱게 갈아 만든 흰 가루이다.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: Pó fino obtido pela moagem do trigo, usado na preparação de alimentos como pão, bolos e massas. No Brasil, a palavra também pode designar qualquer farinha feita de cereais ou raízes.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: Farinha é o grão de trigo moído até se tornar um pó fino.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: Bubuk halus yang diperoleh dari penggilingan biji gandum. Terigu merupakan bahan utama dalam pembuatan roti.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: Terigu halus yang dibuat dari biji gandum.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: แป้งที่ได้จากการบดข้าวสาลีละเอียด นิยมใช้เป็นส่วนผสมหลักของขนมปังและขนมอบอื่น ๆ
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: แป้งข้าวสาลีบดละเอียดที่ใช้ทำขนมปัง

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.definition: Buğday tanelerinin değirmende öğütülmesiyle elde edilen ince un. Ekmek, pasta ve hamur işlerinde kullanılır.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.gloss: Buğdayın öğütülmesiyle elde edilen ince un; ekmeğin ana maddesidir.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.text: Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.translation: แป้งข้าวสาลีผลิตจากการบดข้าวสาลีที่โรงโม่

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.text: Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.translation: Terigu digiling dari gandum di pabrik.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.text: Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.translation: A farinha é feita com trigo no moinho.

f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.text: Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
Flour is made from wheat at the mill.
f55f97cfa0dd5f18c1ac07d2c361b198f19fd852.translation: 小麦粉は製粉所で小麦から作られる。

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: Putting a feeling into words as a way of getting the body back down.
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: Putting a feeling into words as a way of getting the body back down.

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: 強い感情を言葉や声に出して発散させ、身体の高ぶりを下げることをいう。相手への連絡や問題の解決とは別物で、聞かれているとは限らない。
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: 感情を言葉や声にして表し、身心を落ち着かせること。

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: 감정을 말로 꺼내면서 몸에 쌓인 긴장과 흥분을 가라앉히는 것이다. 대화를 통해 해결하거나 상대에게 전달하려는 목적이 반드시 필요한 것은 아니다.
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: 감정을 말로 표현해 몸의 긴장을 가라앉히는 것.

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: A prática de colocar um sentimento em palavras para reduzir a tensão e a ativação do corpo. Um desabafo pode ser intenso e não pressupõe que a outra pessoa compreenda ou resolva o problema.
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: Expressar um sentimento em palavras como forma de acalmar o corpo.

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: Tindakan mengeluarkan perasaan dalam bentuk kata-kata agar tubuh kembali tenang. Ekspresi ini dapat menjadi alat untuk mereda diri, meskipun masalah utamanya belum tentu selesai.
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: Ekspresi emosi melalui Talk untuk menenangkan diri.

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: การพูดความรู้สึกออกมาเพื่อให้ร่างกายและอารมณ์คลายลง โดยไม่จำเป็นต้องเปิดเผยความรู้สึกนั้นต่ออีกฝ่าย
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: การระบายความรู้สึกด้วยการพูด

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.definition: Yoğun bir duyguyu konuşarak veya yazarak boşaltmak; böylece bedensel uyarılmayı azaltmak. Duyguyu paylaşmakla duyguyu bastırmak aynı şey değildir.
f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.gloss: Duyguyu söze dökerek bedeninin yeniden sakinleşmesini sağlamak.

f5b1012a1fb4dbf310cae5c610eaf21c14c6cd26.translation: Duygusunu boşaltması sakinleşmesine yardım etti; karşıdaki kişi buna hiç duymamıştı.
